summarize_h1_constants: summarize the H1 constants module that defines robot body, sensor, and geom identifiers for MuJoCo locomotion
create_feet_sites_list: create a list of foot site names from FEET_SITES for left_foot and right_foot in the H1 robot model
build_feet_geom_lists: build LEFT_FEET_GEOMS and RIGHT_FEET_GEOMS lists for collision and contact geom names in the H1 model
test_root_body_constant: test the ROOT_BODY constant that identifies 'torso_link' as the root body of the H1 humanoid
review_sensor_constants: review the sensor name constants (GRAVITY_SENSOR, GLOBAL_LINVEL_SENSOR, GYRO_SENSOR, etc.) used in H1 MJX environments
